posts.text: Bank Valuation Model Banking (2).xlsx (46.0 KB) I have put together a basic bank valuation model that projects the financials of various Small Finance Banks (SFBs) over the next nine years and estimates the implied investor CAGR under different assumptions. I am not a SEBI-registered investment adviser , and this model does not constitute investment advice or a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any security . It is merely a personal valuation exercise that I am sharing to seek feedback and identify any errors or shortcomings. The model is still in an early stage and has several known limita…
